changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit size bound for the scheduled two-test graph beyond the one-fifth round threshold
changed.statement:
∀ (k r e q : Nat), 0 < q → 3 * e + 2 * q + 3 ≤ r → k + e + 3 = 5 * r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let h := (k + 1) / 2
  let graph : Fin (2 ^ k) → Fin (2 ^ k) → Bool := fun row col =>
    (List.range (2 ^ k)).any (fun w =>
      decide (first w row.val < 2 ^ (k - h)) && decide (second w col.val < 2 ^ (k - h)))
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k + k) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 1000 * (k + 1) ^ 3 * (r + 1) ^ 2 *
      (2 ^ (k - q) + q * Nat.choose (r + (e + q) + 1) (e + q) *
        2 ^ (k - (r - (3 * e + 2 * q + 2)))) ∧
    ∀ bits : Fin (k + k) → Bool,
      C.eval (List.ofFn bits) = PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) graph bits
changed.unlocks: prices both decoders with complete row and column tests
changed.context: Make a slot for every visible raw-key pattern. Fill hidden pivots from highest output down, evaluating the final pre-key bit with the remaining pivots zero. This recovers every passing key outside the exception sets. For each output and history make slots indexed by the starting bits off its earliest m record pivots. Recover those pivots by evaluating each zero parity with its fresh bit set to zero. Check both complete tests on every decoded key and OR. Each slot uses at most r trial evaluations and two full tests.

changed.title: A binomial tail bounds the exceptional slots in a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for the overlapping two-test graph
changed.statement:
∀ (k r e q : Nat), 0 < q → 3 * e + 2 * q + 3 ≤ r → k + e + 3 = 5 * r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let h := (k + 1) / 2
  let graph : Fin (2 ^ k) → Fin (2 ^ k) → Bool := fun row col =>
    (List.range (2 ^ k)).any (fun w =>
      decide (first w row.val < 2 ^ (k - h)) && decide (second w col.val < 2 ^ (k - h)))
  let N := (r - e) - (e + q + 3)
  let D := e + q - 1
  let E := (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), Nat.choose N j) * 2 ^ (k - N)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k + k) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 1000 * (k + 1) ^ 3 * (r + 1) ^ 2 *
      (2 ^ (k - q) + q * E) ∧
    ∀ bits : Fin (k + k) → Bool,
      C.eval (List.ofFn bits) = PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) graph bits
changed.unlocks: prices ordinary and exceptional slots by a binomial tail with explicit decoder wires
changed.context: On paper. Guess the k-q visible raw bits and solve ordinary pivots from the highest tested bit down. For each exceptional output index a slot by an N-bit word with at most D ones and k-N more bits. Stop at zero number m=N-D, at position a. Skip illegal prefixes. The suffix and the extra bits fill exactly the k-a starting positions off the query pivots. In time order probe each guard with its pivot zero and XOR its answer with the target bit. This reconstructs the key. Check both full tests on every candidate and OR. At most r probes and two tests per slot fit the gate budget.

The suffix and the extra bits fill exactly the k-a starting positions off the query pivots. In time order probe each guard with its pivot zero and XOR its answer with the target bit. This reconstructs the key. Check both full tests on every candidate and OR. At most r probes and two tests per slot fit the gate budget.
